'''Ubardia''' was a [[Planet|world]]<ref name="Skeleton Crew">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> in the [[Ubardia system]] in the [[Colonies]],<ref name="Appendix" /> located along the [[Hydian Way]].<ref name="Map" /> Thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Ubardia was a member world in the [[New Republic]], where it was represented by [[Gadde Neshurrion]] in the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TFA VD" />
